I.effect_boundary: Only concrete authorized controlled calls; stop on uncertain submission, wrong recipient or missing authority.

O: private evidence references for recipient and mailbox confirmation
F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Prove that the current prepared-request prototype leaves a complete Japanese message.
steps: Bind an explicitly supplied controlled human recipient and controlled mailbox, exact Japanese text, caller identity and test-call authority. Do not dial sample numbers.
Preview and execute one human-answer scenario and one mailbox scenario using distinct request IDs in one persistent journal.
Obtain recipient confirmation and mailbox playback confirmation; record completeness, start after greeting/beep, caller ID, duration, latency and actual charges.
Repeat an already submitted request ID against the same journal and check provider history for absence of an extra call. Never create a replacement ID automatically after ambiguity.
acceptance: Human recipient confirms the complete intended message.
Mailbox playback confirms the complete message after the greeting/beep.
Provider history and journal reconcile; submitted/ended alone do not count as delivery.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
